method_summary: Fourier-coordinate Groebner generation and minimality analysis
problem_statement: Let S be the 4-sunlet on {1,2,3,4} with circular order (1,2,3,4) and hybrid leaf-child 1. Under the Kimura 3-parameter model in Fourier coordinates, decide whether the full vanishing ideal I(S) is generated by its quadric and cubic invariants, with either explicit Groebner generation certificates or an explicit quartic invariant plus a minimality proof that it lies outside the quadric-cubic span.
recovery_conditions: introduce a materially new method or a justified, still-valuable revised claim; address the recorded limitation: No Groebner generation certificate and no verified minimal quartic were produced; quadric results reproduce published enumeration, cubic survivors lack exact symbolic proof, and the quartic glove-block scan was aborted incomplete at 120000 of 232569 blocks with no span-membership test.
